silver_male.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Boxing athlete for the Silver tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: medium brown skin; narrow angular face; brown eyes; short black centre-part curls; compact athletic build. Older teenager, approximately 15–17; subtly lengthened facial proportions and developing posture, visibly older than Bronze. Collection palette: ink, burnt orange and cream. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Modest short-sleeve boxing training top, mid-length shorts and boxing boots for both. Older-teen fitted kit with subtle secondary-colour side panels. Equipment: Correct boxing gloves or hand wraps; no belts, injuries, fight scene or bare torso. Award: One small original silver participation medallion Pose: relaxed three-quarter guard without combat scene; preserve the stated tier age and a readable unobstructed face. Tier silhouette direction: Turn torso toward the opposite side from Bronze; present early recognition with a pleased, modest expression and clearly different hand placement. Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.
